content_plan.title: Seasonal Storyline Carousel
content_plan.objective: Invite home cooks in Alder Vale to join the waitlist for the autumn fruit box by showcasing seasonal variety and recipe inspiration.
content_plan.key_message: An autumn fruit box brings seasonal variety and simple recipe inspiration to the kitchen. Interested home cooks can join the waitlist to hear more.
content_plan.draft_caption: Explore the colors of autumn in your kitchen. From crisp fruit close‑ups to recipe ideas, discover how seasonal variety can spark everyday cooking. Join the waitlist to learn more.
content_plan.visual_direction: Slide 1: close‑up of assorted autumn fruit (no specific varieties named). Slide 2: gentle packing scene with a basket and a handwritten recipe card. Slide 3: a simple recipe card illustration featuring a generic fruit dish. Slide 4: a neutral graphic with 'Join the Waitlist' text, no product imagery.

content_plan.visual_direction: A single general fruit close‑up or recipe‑card image, no specific fruit or dish named.

content_plan.title: Kitchen Companion Waitlist Section
content_plan.objective: Provide clear information about the autumn fruit box concept and invite Alder Vale home cooks to join the waitlist for updates.
content_plan.key_message: An autumn fruit box brings seasonal variety and simple recipe inspiration to the kitchen. Interested home cooks can join the waitlist to hear more.
content_plan.draft_caption: Discover how a seasonal fruit box can add variety and spark new recipe ideas in your kitchen. Join our waitlist to stay informed about upcoming autumn offerings.
content_plan.visual_direction: General packing‑scene or recipe‑card imagery, no specific fruit or dish shown. Include a neutral 'Join the Waitlist' graphic; no functional form or URL is assumed.

findings.excerpt: Autumn’s bounty is ready to inspire your next dish. Think fresh fruit, simple recipes, and a touch of seasonal charm. Want to learn more? Join the waitlist.

claim_check.scope: known lexical claims only; human review remains required

notes: All three requested deliverables and allowed channels are covered with concrete plan items.
The Instagram caption introduces fresh fruit and the availability-like phrase 'Autumn's bounty is ready,' which are not supported by the brief.
No exact fruit varieties, prices, delivery details, certifications, testimonials, stock claims, functional form, URL, or link-in-bio destination are introduced.
The first two visual directions no longer state that assets are proposed or require availability and rights confirmation, weakening the approved handoff constraint.

The three items remain closely related through a shared pillar and repeated key message, but their carousel, concise-caption, and informational-section treatments are usable and more differentiated than the Phase 2C baseline.
